text:
Jess (CSM): Quick thread: ZenithCo dedicated bring-up next Tue. Need final quota rows, autoscale policy, and a short post-go-live plan. Renewal check-in same week so we should collect metrics + feedback first 72h.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Understood. What numbers are we validating?
Priya (SRE): Suggested targets: idle 80 qps, steady 220 qps, bursts to 650 qps for up to 5m. Test plan: smoke 5m, ramp 25m, soak 50m.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll prep scripts. Will run a KV prime 24h pre-ramp with the customer's prompt set.
Taylor (Support): I'll be on-call for the window. Share alert thresholds so I can prep runbook snippets.
Priya (SRE): Alerts: error_rate > 0.8% for 60s, p95 > 550ms for 2m, p99 > 1100ms => pager. Fallback rule: route to quantized smaller model if p95 > 750ms.
Ravi (Product): Product asks for a quick cost-guard: circuit-breaker for routes tagged "beta" and a tiny feedback card embedded in the enablement email.
Jess (CSM): I'll send the renewal owner a heads-up and include the enablement deck + 3-question feedback link. We'll keep this account high-touch for 14 days post go-live.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll run:

```
./storm --target https://staging.redwood/zenith --rps 220 --duration 50m --pattern ramp --header "x-customer:zenith"
```

Omar (Solutions Eng): KV priming:

```
python tools/seed_kv.py --acct zenith --prompts zenith_corpus.json --concurrency 6
```

Priya (SRE): Draft autoscale policy:

```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 10
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 430
  window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 120
```

Taylor (Support): I'll publish support playbook and a one-page troubleshooting checklist (where to look: model fallbacks, token-cost spikes, request traces). I'll also create the CSAT + post-incident form to send at T+48h.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled 2024-08-09T02:00Z for zenith/onboard - ticket #CS-7123 :white_check_mark:
Omar (Solutions Eng): Proposed windows:
- Mon 02:00 UTC: KV warmup (10m)
- Mon 03:00 UTC: smoke (5m)
- Mon 03:30 UTC: ramp (25m)
- Tue 01:00 UTC: soak (50m) + go-live verification
Jess (CSM): Ops signed off. Action items:
1) Priya: commit autoscale policy + add runbook link.
2) Omar: upload load scripts + raw metrics artifact.
3) Taylor: publish support playbook + wire CSAT.
4) Jess: send renewal note + enablement deck + feedback link.
Please ping here when complete. :thumbsup:
